anchor.semantic_hook: The call within 'j'en appelle à' is made visible by a formal appeal chamber organized around a handbell aimed toward a listening dais.
anchor.setting: An empty civic appeal chamber contains a semicircular desk, a plain lectern, and a handbell facing a listening dais. The single absurd feature is the handbell enlarged to the height of the lectern, turning the act of calling upon someone into architecture.
anchor.absurd_element: a lectern-height handbell aimed toward the listening dais

variations.scene_adjust: Two tightly interlocked wooden pieces rest on the semicircular desk.

variations.scene_adjust: A project model and an open collection bowl sit beside the handbell.

variations.scene_adjust: An uneven balance scale and a sealed decision folder occupy the desk.

variations.scene_adjust: A grocery basket, folded blanket, and house keys wait beside the lectern.

inserts.action: beckons toward the dais, then studies a worn tool kit while easing a jammed wooden mechanism back into motion

variations.scene_adjust: A worn tool kit and a jammed wooden mechanism sit on the desk.

anchor.semantic_hook: The literal idea of something never seen is staged as a viewing hall whose central exhibit is watched by a permanently closed eye.
anchor.setting: An empty circular viewing hall has a central exhibit plinth, a ring of benches, and tall windows. The single absurd feature is a colossal closed eye suspended over the plinth, physically unable to see whatever is displayed below.
anchor.absurd_element: a colossal closed eye suspended above the central exhibit

inserts.action: stands at the central plinth in a winter coat, catching snow in one hand while staring in disbelief at flowering branches beyond the window

variations.scene_adjust: Heavy snow falls beyond the tall windows onto trees full of spring blossoms.

variations.scene_adjust: A new featureless phone and several detachable camera pieces occupy the central plinth.

variations.scene_adjust: Three gold medals and athletic gear are arranged on the plinth.
